test_title: PYST 03: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] Let's analyze the pattern for each letter-cluster pair by finding the relationship between the two letters in each pair. **1) NM - PO** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63204f3bfff7f8c438f075f84cbbe08ed5aca5146440584b7f32c680e94effc3.png] Pattern: First letter +2, Second letter +2. **2) SR - UT**
